headline: Manual routing decisions are costing the prospect roughly 12% of fleet capacity every week

bullets.text: Dispatchers re-plan routes manually when conditions change mid-day
sub: Average of 45 minutes lost per re-plan, three times a day

bullets.text: Fleet utilization sits at 71%, below the 85% the prospect's peers report
The current dispatch tool has no live traffic or capacity feed

annotation: None of these are staffing problems; they are tooling gaps a platform switch fixes directly.
